desc: Positive L2 distance error causes hand to fly to boundary
Hovering near door handle pays continuous bonus without pulling
code:
def reward_components(s, a, s2):
    c = {}
    c["step"] = -0.01
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(s2["hand_pos"]) - np.array(s2["obj_pos"])))
    c["near_handle"] = 2.0 if d < 0.08 else 0.0
    c["goal"] = 5.0 if s2.get("in_target", False) else 0.0
    return c

desc: Spamming gripper opening and closing near object farms reward
code:
def reward_components(s, a, s2):
    c = {}
    c["step"] = -0.01
    c["reach"] = -1.0 * float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(s2["hand_pos"]) - np.array(s2["obj_pos"])))
    c["grip_action"] = 1.5 if abs(a[3]) > 0.5 else 0.0
    c["goal"] = 10.0 if s2.get("in_target", False) else 0.0
    return c
